title: Log drains
desc: Forward this server's container logs to an external sink. Logs are batched and shipped continuously. Pick a target: generic HTTP (Tugra batch JSON, e.g. Axiom/custom), Grafana Loki, Datadog, syslog (RFC 5424), GELF (Graylog) or fluentd (Forward). Leave the container filter empty to ship every Tugra container on the server.
descApp: Forward only this app's container logs to an external sink: its container, its rolling-deploy twin, compose services and swarm tasks. Other apps and databases on the same server never reach this drain. Logs from this app also reach any server-wide drain.
name: Name
typeChangeDropsToken: Changing the type removes the stored token or shared key. Enter a new one below if the new type needs it, and fill in the endpoint fields.
sharedKeyKeep: Shared key set — blank to keep
caCertHelp: Added to the system trust store for this drain. Certificate verification is always on.
containersHelpApp: Compose services to ship (empty = every container of the app). Press Enter to add.
containersHelpServer: Container name patterns (* and ?), for example tugra_db_*. Empty = every Tugra container on this server. Press Enter to add.
containersNotApplicable: The container filter only applies to compose apps that are not deployed to a swarm. This drain ships every container of the app.
allowPrivateHelp: Lets this drain reach private and internal network addresses from the server (not localhost: that is the agent itself, use the server's own address). Needs server operator permission.
appDrainsOnServer: App drains shipping from this server
appDrainsOnServerEmpty: No app drains ship logs from this server.
err_auth: the server requires user authentication, which a shared key cannot provide
udpWarn: UDP is fire-and-forget: Tugra cannot confirm delivery, and lines can be lost on the way.
lossNote: Delivery is best-effort. Lines emitted while the agent is disconnected are not buffered, and a line can be delivered twice after a restart.
previewNote: Preview deployments, clones and config snapshots do not include log drains.
validation_url: Enter a valid http:// or https:// URL.
validation_host: Enter a host name or IP address, without a scheme or path.
validation_facility: Facility must be a whole number from 0 to 23.
validation_tag: Tag: up to four dot-separated parts of letters, digits, _ or -.
validation_caCert: The CA certificate must be a PEM block starting with -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----.
validation_serverName: Enter a valid TLS server name.
validation_container_app: Compose service names use lowercase letters, digits, . _ - only.
validation_container_server: Container patterns may only contain letters, digits, _ . - and the wildcards * ?
